name: BikeTrack: Indoor Workouts
subtitle: Indoor rides on Apple Watch
promotionalText: Connect compatible Bluetooth equipment to Apple Watch. Follow your effort, explore heart-rate and power zones, and save your workouts to Apple Health.
description:
Bring your indoor workout together on Apple Watch.

BikeTrack connects directly to compatible Bluetooth bikes and treadmills, combines equipment measurements with your Watch's heart rate and active energy, and saves authorized workout data to Apple Health and Fitness.

YOUR SESSION, AT A GLANCE
See power, cadence, speed, distance, elapsed time, heart rate, and active energy when available. Pause, resume, and end your workout from your wrist.

UNDERSTAND YOUR EFFORT
Set your measured maximum heart rate and cycling FTP. Follow live heart-rate and power charts, then explore your workout's averages, peaks, and time in each training zone. Keep your latest 100 workout summaries on your Watch.

RIDES, RUNS, AND WALKS
Record indoor cycling, running, or walking. Use metric or imperial units. You can also record without connected equipment, using the measurements available from your Watch.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, analytics SDK, or subscription. Workout data stays in your app storage and Apple Health, subject to your Apple settings. Optional diagnostics are shared only when you choose.

TRY A DEMO
Explore the interface with a clearly labeled demo ride. Simulated demo data never writes to Apple Health or workout history.

COMPATIBILITY
Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 11 or later. Equipment must broadcast standard Bluetooth FTMS Indoor Bike or Treadmill Data, Cycling Power, or Cycling Speed & Cadence. Available metrics depend on your equipment; specific models are not guaranteed. BikeTrack connects to one peripheral at a time. ANT+, resistance control, and direct Strava export are not included.

Training zones are based on values you supply. BikeTrack is a fitness tracker, not a medical device.
reviewNotes:
BikeTrack is a watch-only app. The iOS target is Apple's required distribution container and has no iPhone UI. Install and review on Apple Watch (watchOS 11+).

No sign-in, purchase, subscription, or reviewer account is needed.

To review without Bluetooth equipment: scroll the home screen and select Try demo ride. The DEMO label remains visible. Swipe right for Pause, Resume, and End workout; swipe left for heart-rate and power charts. End the demo to inspect its summary and chart detail. Demo data is simulated and never writes to Health or history.

For a real workout: choose Indoor ride, Indoor run, or Indoor walk. Connect compatible equipment or select Record without equipment, grant Health permissions, and start recording. Swipe right, then End and Save. Equipment metrics require a peripheral advertising standard FTMS, Cycling Power, or Cycling Speed & Cadence services. No proprietary equipment integration is claimed.

Privacy policy: home screen > Settings > Privacy policy (bundled for offline reading). Diagnostics are optional and local; sharing requires an explicit user action.

App contains no non-exempt encryption.
